notes: Riff is an Electron app (vanilla JS renderer + local Node API server). For the browser, .ui-capture/server.js (started by start.sh on $PORT) serves src/renderer as the site root (/assets from repo assets), injects a preload stand-in, persists localStorage through storage.json, proxies /api to the real server and stubs external services. Tools pinned in mise.toml (node 24.11.1); deps via `ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 npm ci`; helper packages in .ui-capture/tools. Data: .ui-capture/seed.js generates seed/storage.json (the app's own localStorage keys) and start.sh regenerates it and copies it to runtime/storage.json on every start: 138 liked songs added over ~10 months, 100-play history (latest session tonight), 14 playlists (late night drive, deep focus, lofi / study, sad girl autumn, GYM, Ukrainian and Russian post-punk lists, a wedding first-dance shortlist, a Spotify-imported Discover Weekly, a YT Music import, an empty 'new playlist'), 17 saved albums, 20 followed artists, search history, 2 custom audio presets, and a paused 'now playing' (Fred again.. – adore u at 1:14 with an 8-track queue). Main areas: Home (For you / My Wave, liked songs, favorite artists, trending, top chart), sidebar library (playlists/albums/queue), Liked songs, History, Albums, artist and album pages, search, player bar with lyrics/visualizer/audio editor, Settings modal.
